headline: Re-cut to the spec's own gate rules, the living-update is an honest partial: only 3 of 14 countries are OECD level-validated (DK, FR, NL), and among them the paper's 'in-work transfer beats demogrant' result holds in just 1 of 3 (France; Denmark's and the Netherlands' trade-off is numerically undefined in 2026) — the widely-quoted '8 of 10' is a descriptive, OECD-unvalidated statistic.

On the validated set the 1998 value (3 of 3, Table 5b no-UB) drops to 1 of 3 in 2026 — because Denmark and the Netherlands have numerically undefined Ψ, not because the ranking reverses.

figures.caption: Gate-3b PTR change for a single adult at 67% AW, 2010→2025 (DK/NL →2024): this study (left bars) vs the OECD TaxBEN change benchmark (blue). This is the gate-3b hypothetical-household change, not a bottom-quintile rate. Only DK, FR, NL pass the change gate (green, V_Δ). Spain, Italy and Portugal are contradicted by the benchmark (ES +34.7 vs +9.8; IT +22.9 vs -7.4, opposite sign; PT -11.2 vs +16.6 at AW67 and -9.9 vs +9.4 at MINW, opposite sign at both levels) and are removed from the PTR-change metric.
figures.alt: Bar chart of single-adult 67%-AW PTR change by country, our estimate vs OECD, colour-coded by gate-3b validation status; ES, IT, PT marked contradicted

notes: This card SUPERSEDES the 001/002/003/004 cards for publication (artifact-level correction). The old studies' numbers trace and are unchanged; their reporting violated the spec's validation rules (provenance audit §2–§3, §7). Old studies stay on disk untouched.
Status partial: FR and EL remain τ-unvalidated (gate-3c MTR add-on aborts on retry); the headline is an honest partial because |V| = 3 < 10.

005 closes the six presentation items from the audit re-check on 004: (1) the corrected 14-country trade-off table (results/tradeoff_table_corrected.csv, incl. EL & LU; DK beta-step-dependent, ES OECD-contradicted); (2) added card_corrections rows for the 002 and 003 cards; (3) Fig 1 relabelled to gate-3b single-adult-67%-AW; (4) Portugal labelled OECD-contradicted; (5) the -1.2 pp all-14 figure moved to a note and metric-1 gate years set to 2010–2025; (6) core-hours 0.48 and the §2–§3/§7 citation.

The '8 of 10' survives only as a descriptive, unvalidated statistic; the validated-set claim is '1 of 3, France only, DK & NL undefined'. Neither softened nor inflated — the Ψ-instability (bottom-decile ≈100% traps) is itself the finding.

Full old→corrected claim map in results/card_corrections.csv (18 rows); the per-item change log is results/fix_log.md. The 1998 no-UB baseline (baseline_1998_noUB.csv) and the 003 addendum (findings_addendum_003.md) live read-only in 004/results.

Compute 0.48 core-h = 001+002 combined (001 0.22 logged + 002 0.26 logged; 0.30 was 002's self-report; the '0.7' was untraceable); 004's three gate completions added ~0.1; 005 is presentation-only (table assembly + re-rendering Fig 1) and adds negligible compute. No data fetched; no EUROMOD run in 005.
